decisions.reason: Archiving and reporting software is central to the firm's push toward data-driven, web-based infrastructure management, and with growth and hiring providing slack there is no shortfall that would trigger problemistic search.
B overlaps with A and has only a minor web presence, which makes consolidation plausible, but without evidence of a performance gap and with slack from growth, management carries it another year.
The manhole door with integrated railing is a low-cost hardware extension serving steady municipal safety demand, so its results likely meet aspirations and dropping it is unlikely.
The floating sludge extractor fits the core water-treatment machinery offer, and in the absence of a reported shortfall, organisational slack lets the firm keep it despite its limited visibility.
Flow measurement automation software is close to the established offer, has its own page, and supports the data-driven strategy, so management keeps it while its results mature.
